reason: Spec E-20260928-11 tests whether write-time fact extraction loses answer accuracy against retained source artifacts at the same retriever, reader and judge, with a matched-token control and a single static reader prompt that removes the source's prompt confound; it can move B16 (lead) from skills to facts and add a second negative measurement under B5 (working). It takes this run's exploration slot because it is cheap, the source effect (94.2% to 87.8% with recall unchanged) is large and one-variable, and it decides the ingestion write path before extraction becomes canonical.
